'''2023 Champions League''' was the Players Committee Champions League knockout on GEMP, January 2023. [[Joe Olson]] won the Finals.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-1-champions-league-knockout-round/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' January 2023
